decisions.reason: The glass flake spraying system was launched only in 2023 and its market value is still uncertain, while keeping it open costs little because it builds on the firm's core spraying know-how and in-house manufacturing.

The injection pump already has its own web page, a sign of deliberate commitment, and it fits the firm's injection and construction repair business, so the option is cheap to hold while demand becomes clear.
The transfer pump extends the core material conveying portfolio at low marginal cost, and one year on the market is too little evidence to justify abandoning it.
Fire protection flow monitoring supports the firm's goal of digitalized production and is featured prominently, so with its prospects still unresolved the option should stay open.
